body.x: ChoisTechnology(representative Soon-pil Choi, www.choistec.com) has been showing show wireless presenter 'X-pointer XPM145' at CES 2012(Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).
(Picture1: Richard Meaders of ChoisTechnology introduces 'X-pointer XPM145')

'XPM145' has been developed through 'ChoisTechnology's technique skill that has been advanced over 10 years. It's equipped with Laser and it has special Brightness more than two times than normal red laser, also clear pointing is available at long distances.

Especially, the color of laser pointer is outstanding. Almost laser color is red. But XPM145 has orange color. It has special Brightness more than two times than normal red laser, also clear pointing is available even at long distances.ChoisTechnology said "Orange color can draw an attention of audience, bright and pleasant presentation is also available"

In addition Magic series has 'Magic Key function' that can change executive command program of button by simple operation. And XPM145 can be used as all powerful remote control by designating hot keys of bookmarks with 'Magic key' function. But the most attractive thing is what solving a problem generated because of different key value on Prezi, Macintosh, Keynote and others.
Above these, there is an battery usage check function, also Black Pearl provides plating premium and luxury design. And it's pleasing to the touch.

ChoisTechnology said, "We introduced wireless presentation pointer in Korea, also we are leading domestic wireless presentation pointer market and we will focus on upgrading the powerful brand image of 'X-pointer"

Meanwhile, Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing including finding buyers, market research and others for CES held in Las vegas, US. IITPA has been supporting cracking American market of 8 export promising companies.
